name: Tadasugawa Rei
source: A third-year student who is the "military tactician" of the "SS" committee, or in other words, controls their members. She doesn't tolerate people who break rules, and always tells the [url=/c71526]protagonist[/url], who often runs away from Rei, that corridors are the perfect places to have sex at, among other things.
